title: Bandcamp Merch Attach Rate
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:bandcamp merch_bundle=* merch_attached=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(merch_attached="yes",1,0))) as matched by merch_bundle
| eval merch_attached_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - merch_attached_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Bandcamp orders that end with merch attached by merch bundle.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which merch bundle are helping or hurting Bandcamp orders.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `merch attached` on `music:bandcamp` events and summarize the hit rate by `merch_bundle`.
visualization: Table of merch bundle with percentage of Bandcamp orders ending with merch attached.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often merch attached happens for each merch bundle so you can see where Bandcamp orders go smoothly or get stuck.
